mechanism_claims.claim_text: CPP5 cell entry is not clearly explained by the tested endocytosis/pinocytosis inhibitors; cytochalasin D partially attenuated Tamra-VPTLK entry, while other tested inhibitors did not block Fam-labeled VPTLK/KLPVM entry.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The paper frames the mechanism as unresolved; only a cytochalasin D-sensitive component for Tamra-labeled peptide is supported.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: CPP5 entry/cytoprotection was observed in proteoglycan-deficient CHO A745 cells and in Jurkat cells reported to lack caveolin-mediated endocytotic activity, supporting that proteoglycan and caveolin-mediated endocytosis are not required for the observed CPP5 entry readouts.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This supports pathway exclusion in the tested cell systems, not a complete receptor or membrane-translocation mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: No primary antimicrobial or anticancer killing mechanism assay is present in the reopened local XML/PDF/OA/database materials; DRAMP antimicrobial/anticancer labels remain database-source conflicts.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: DRAMP34806/VPTLK antimicrobial and anticancer database labels
mechanism_claims.limitations: The primary paper supports cell penetration, cytoprotection, and protein transduction; it does not test microbial targets, MIC/MBC, hemolysis, or cancer-cell killing.
